title: Position the Workforce Registry within an NHWA-aligned information system
requirements:
- Say what the registry is not: employment, payroll, HR actions and detailed learning records
- Lead with workforce planning and policy use; present NHWA reporting as a by-product
- Describe the national HRHIS as a system of systems, with the registry as one source alongside HRIS, payroll, education and surveys
- Support multiple occupation classifications
- Acknowledge multiple HRIS and federated arrangements
- Map registry elements to specific NHWA indicators and other required sources
- Map NHWA indicators to their data sources and state external denominator dependencies
- Treat employment attributes as sourced, effective-dated links
